dependency_evidence: Cole et al. directly observed T. antithetica pollination and oviposition on Y. jaegeriana; Joshua tree-yucca moth reproduction is an obligate brood-pollination mutualism and the eastern association is the Y. jaegeriana/T. antithetica pair.
witness_selection_rule: Use all 17 Table-1 T. antithetica eastern sites (IDs 18-34). Every admitted site has positive moth microsatellite and/or moth ovipositor evidence. Exclude all three Tikaboo contact-zone sites and all western T. synthetica sites before taxonomy or occurrence access.
host_range_evidence: USDA Forest Service FEIS: eastern Joshua tree occurs on 1,987,636 ha across Arizona, California, Nevada, and Utah; this stable non-occurrence range authority satisfies the prospective multi-region host-breadth screen.
known_boundary: JOS002 was selected only after the 2026-08-01 GBIF monthly snapshot metadata+schema were frozen. No snapshot occurrence row, taxon count, map, cell statistic, or live-search result was used for selection. JOS001 and all earlier pairs remain firewalled.
